{{Quote|Command of Gray Squadron is now with Gray Ten.''"<br />"''This is Gray Ten. Herkan Base is probably firing on automatic programming. No emotions or intentions to detect.|"Gray One" Jaina Solo and "Gray Ten" Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
'''Gray Ten''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilot]] [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer|Tyria Sarkin]] as part of [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles']] [[Wraith Squadron|Gray Squadron]], which Sarkin later gave the name Wraith Squadron&mdash;she continued flying in the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] as [[Wraith Ten (callsign)|Wraith Ten]].<ref name="Wraith">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref> As a member of the [[New Jedi Order]], Tyria Sarkin later flew in its [[Gray Squadron (New Jedi Order)|Gray Squadron]] as Gray Ten as well. During the [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] turned over her [[StealthX]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]&mdash;along with its [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] and corresponding call sign of Gray Ten&mdash;to Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] upon his request. Gray Squadron's [[Commanding officer/Legends|leader]], "Gray One" [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], promptly handed command of the Jedi [[StealthX wing]] group to Skywalker.<ref name="Conviction" />
